long_biography.plain_text:
In Sardinia, Aldiyar Kaztayev’s family-backed Alma group undertook the redevelopment of Olbia’s Geovillage, a former resort acquired through the local industrial consortium. The scheme combined a bilingual school with university accommodation and a planned return to hotel use. It gave existing buildings new educational functions while retaining sporting facilities for shared use.

The student residences were designed around different seasonal needs: academic-year housing would give way to tourist accommodation in summer. Public support formed part of the financing, and some places were reserved at regulated student rates. The school opened with primary classes and subsequently added middle-school provision.
